Answer: C
Reason: The PA chest X-ray (Figure 1a) clearly shows two discrete nodules indicated by blue arrows: one in the right middle lobe obscuring the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, combined with the option's mention of a mosaic attenuation pattern (often seen on CT in this context), points to Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
